mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at 0.12% is historically low, and such low rates have been associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed discount rates and accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (as of 2015-05-15).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) above 900 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 400,000 signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through increased corporate revenue and confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 900 AND RSAFS > 400000.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output declines, signaling reduced economic activity and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to lower corporate earnings and risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of housing starts (HOUST) at 926.0 thousand units is above the 900 threshold, and historically, such levels have been associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to strong consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 236.0 (as of 2015-05-15, CPIAUCSL=235.74) signals accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated monetary tightening and reduced real returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 236.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 140,000 and a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.3% signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through increased consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 140000 AND UNRATE < 5.3%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 236.0), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened expectations of monetary policy tightening and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 236.0.
